name: Maker Hip
author: Maker Hip
tagline: eight tracks of sounds, easy to follow
description: A test build. Eight tracks, each with one sound from a single list of 69 built-in sounds, all at the same loudness; three slots for samples from the Burger Studio app; the keys play the selected track; four knobs shape it (pitch, a DJ filter, decay, level); two effect slots a track (delay, echo, reverb, tape speed, robot, flanger, overdrive, chorus, lo-fi), one knob each; an envelope and an LFO a track; a looper on track 8 (OCT- and OCT+ together); MIDI clock out, or in; a basic 16-step page; a limiter on the output. The tracks and steps are not saved yet.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp (MPL-2.0), from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hugelton Instruments). Sounds: Maker Hip's own Rock kit and FM bank; the Hugelton Sample Pack by Leo Kuroshita (CC0); Versilian Studios VCSL (CC0); audio rendered from Felucca's presets, with thanks to Leo Kuroshita.
